title: Fleet Unit Incentive Amount on Vehicle Purchase Agreements
content:
**Fleet accounting rule, Vehicle Purchase Agreements, Fleet Vehicle Purchase Agreement**

The fleet unit incentive credited on a qualifying deal is the deal type's fleet incentive per unit. That figure is the per-unit amount of the incentive.

## How the amount is put together

1. **Summed incentive.** Every amount added to the per-unit amount is added first, giving the summed incentive.
2. **Adjustment.** Any adjustment to the summed incentive comes next.
3. **Rounding.** Rounding to the cent comes last.

The fleet unit incentive is rounded to the cent, half up. It is credited once to the deal as a payment by manufacturer incentive, dated the handling date.

| Element | Treatment |
|---|---|
| Per-unit amount | The deal type's fleet incentive per unit |
| Rounding | To the cent, half up, as the last step |
| How it is booked | One payment credit by manufacturer incentive on the deal |
| Date of the credit | The handling date |
| Number of credits per deal | Once |

## Worked example (hypothetical figure)

This figure is chosen only to show the steps. It is not a schedule value.

A hypothetical deal type carries a fleet incentive per unit of 987.655.

- Per-unit amount: 987.655.
- Rounded to the cent, half up: 987.66.
- Credited once to the deal on the handling date as a payment by manufacturer incentive, for 987.66.
